thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU memory pressure detected in cluster 'us-west-2-prod' pool-gamma-2. OOM rate rising, recent CUDA errors observed. Autoscale not triggering as expected.

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-INC-8721 - gpu-memory-pressure (severity: high). Paging 'eng-oncall'.

Alex (oncall): acked via PD. I'm looking. Which customers are hitting this?

Jess (support): seeing error spikes for customer_acme and customer_pixl; support tickets #5421 and #5423 show 500s with 'cuda allocation failed' messages.

Maya (ml-infra): can you paste the node/pod IDs? I want nvidia-smi and pod logs.

Alex (oncall): pulled a faulty pod id: model-serving-ff12 on node g2-34. attaching recent logs:
```
2026-03-14T18:01:12Z ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
2026-03-14T18:01:12Z WARN kvcache: evicted prefix entries
2026-03-14T18:01:13Z ERROR inference: OOM when allocating KV cache 512MB
```

Sam (sre): nvidia-smi from node g2-34:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12    Driver Version: 525.85.12    CUDA Version: 12.1     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0   A100-80GB    On            | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off | N/A                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
| GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                     GPU Memory |
| 0      0    0      12981   C+Ge  python                             79018MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

Maya (ml-infra): yeah that's saturated — one process pinned almost entire 80GB. Could be runaway KV cache from long-context chat sessions.

Ryan (platform): Autoscaler logs show failed scale up attempts due to quota exhaustion in us-west-2; there were 2 failed requests in the last 10m.

Alex (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) drain g2-34 and migrate running pods to other nodes, 2) kill offending process if migration stalls, 3) temporarily enable model fallback to 4-bit quantized variant for high-memory models. Any objections?

Maya (ml-infra): go ahead. For killing, use: `kubectl exec -it model-serving-ff12 -- pkill -f run_inference` if drain doesn't finish in 30s. I'll prepare the fallback config and push to feature-flag so routing can fallback.

Sam (sre): starting drain: `kubectl drain g2-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

pagerduty: PD escalation: paging escalation level 2 to 'ml-infra' and 'platform'.

Maya (ml-infra): ack. I'm on it. Pushing fallback flag now.

Alex (oncall): drain started, pods are cordoning. One pod stuck at Terminating for 45s.

Sam (sre): killed the stuck container process on the node (ssh & `docker kill`). Pod terminated, scheduler placed two pods on g2-37 and g2-39.

Jess (support): customer_acme reports errors dropping rapidly. Ticket #5421 updated: "errors reduced since 18:03 UTC".

Maya (ml-infra): fallback rollouts complete for the busiest model routes. Routing service shows 22% of requests served by quantized model, latency slightly higher but stable.

Ryan (platform): opened a short-term capacity increase request with cloud team to add 2 more g2 nodes; quota request submitted — ETA 12m.

Alex (oncall): determining root customer impact: initial window ~18:00-18:06 UTC. ~120 failed requests across 3 customers, degraded tail latency for others. No data exfiltration.

pagerduty: PD note: incident acknowledged by Alex, escalated to Maya and Ryan. PD status: acknowledged -> in_progress.

Maya (ml-infra): also seeing sporadic CUDA driver warnings in kernel log — scheduling a reboot of g2-34 after we confirm nothing critical remains.

Sam (sre): node reboot scheduled for 18:15 UTC. Drained state confirmed.

Alex (oncall): handoff: I'm staying to finish the incident writeup, Maya will lead recovery and driver check after reboot. Sam will monitor autoscaler and node replacements.

Maya (ml-infra): post-reboot checks: will run `nvidia-smi -q` and run diagnostic job for KV cache leak reproducer. If reproducer shows leak, we'll force a patch to limit KV cache to 24GB per-worker and add eviction policy.

Jess (support): notified affected customers with status update and ETA for full recovery. No SLA breaches expected after mitigation but will monitor.

Alex (oncall): incident status: mitigated -> partial_recovery. Opening incident ticket: https://redwood.ai/incidents/PD-INC-8721 (internal).

pagerduty: PD note: escalation resolved, incident moved to 'monitoring'.

Ryan (platform): leaving a TODO: validate autoscaler retry/backoff logic for quota errors (task INF-2045).

Maya (ml-infra): follow-up actions: 1) add KV cache upper bound config (INF-2038), 2) add alert for sustained single-process GPU memory > 75% (INF-2039), 3) run canary with long-context sessions to reproduce.

Alex (oncall): thanks all. I'm marking this thread for postmortem and will assign owners. :thumbsup:

Sam (sre): :thumbsup: handing off monitoring to on-call rotation.

Maya (ml-infra): :eyes: will update when driver diag done.

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-8721 transitioned to 'Monitoring' at 18:12 UTC.

Alex (oncall): last_msg: will write the postmortem draft by EOD and link in this thread.
